agent.name: Promethean Technology Classification Agent
agent.specialty: Broad technological significance (incremental / breakthrough / potentially Promethean) and its bounded weight in a present application decision

analytical_question: Is agentic AI incremental, a breakthrough, or potentially Promethean, and how much should that broad significance influence this organization's present decision about the specified application?
general_et_finding: Classification: Potentially Promethean (mode: Potential Promethean - emerging, not yet verified). Confidence: Moderate. Layer 1: agentic AI is a deployed system, not an unassembled component; LLMs combined with tools and a control loop are commercially offered and integrated across major AI products (E14, E15). Layer 2 barrier statement: Before this technology, carrying out multi-step knowledge work across digital systems required a human to perform each step; this was not experienced as a limitation but as the definition of white-collar work. Suppression test: increasingly no. Software development and other workflows are being rebuilt around agents (31% of developers already use agents, E13; more than 10,000 public MCP servers and support across major AI products, E14), so removal would disrupt systems now being built on top of it. Dissolution is emerging. Layer 3: order-of-magnitude - Supported (OSWorld agent accuracy about 5% to 66.3% in one year, E5; task horizons doubling about every seven months, E4); widespread impact - Supported (about 80% of US workers have at least 10% of tasks exposed, E3; generative AI adoption faster than PCs or the internet, E5, E6); paradigm shift - Supported (software that directs its own process rather than following predefined code paths, E15); catalytic effect - Supported (open protocol ecosystem and a new foundation, E14); democratizing effect - Partial (34% gains for novice workers, E7); irreversibility - Unknown (verifiable only after the fact, C1). Tiers: economic activity (execution of digital work) and cognitive and social life (how people learn, write and seek information) - two tiers. This matches the course timeline, which lists generative AI as Potential Promethean (C1, slide 20). The technology-level classification does not change with the organization.
application_finding: Application significance: Incremental to modest. The SPS workflow draws only lightly on the barrier: it automates retrieval of approved information, clarification and appointment requests inside a human-approved process. SPS already offers a public chatbot, Violet (E17), so the proposal extends an existing channel. This agrees with the Assignment 3 classification of a sustaining process innovation (C3). The application does not need to be Promethean to be useful.
organization_specific_finding: The memo's claims are not evidence: an executive's comparison to fire, record investment and media enthusiasm are market excitement (C2, E16, E5). However, the peer school's AI-first announcement and the vendor's claims signal real market momentum. Because agentic AI is potentially Promethean and competitors are moving, SPS should accelerate its evaluation and consider moving from a bounded pilot to a broader rollout if the pilot succeeds within two quarters. Full immediate deployment is not justified.

evidence.claim: Course instrument: barrier statement, suppression test, six criteria, tiers and Confirmed/Potential mode; generative AI shown as Potential Promethean on the course timeline.
evidence.source_or_reference: [C1] Fortino, ET Promethean Technologies FA26, slides 7-10, 15-17, 19-20
evidence.notes: Framework, not evidence about agentic AI.

evidence.claim: Agent capability on computer-use tasks rose from about 5% to 66.3% in one year, below a 72.35% human baseline.
Frontier 50% time horizon about 50 minutes, doubling roughly every seven months since 2019.
About 80% of US workers could have at least 10% of tasks affected; LLMs show traits of general-purpose technologies.
Nearly 40% of US adults 18-64 use generative AI; adoption faster than PCs and the internet.
evidence.source_or_reference: [E6] Bick, Blandin, Deming, NBER WP 32966. https://www.nber.org/papers/w32966

evidence.claim: 31% of developers currently use AI agents.
More than 10,000 public MCP servers; protocol donated to a Linux Foundation agentic AI foundation.
A conversational assistant raised support productivity 14%, 34% for novices.
SPS publicly offers phone/email contact, appointments, information sessions and a chatbot named Violet.
Assignment 3 classified the SPS proposal as incremental, sustaining process innovation with Moderate conditional exposure.
evidence.source_or_reference: [C3] Assignment 3 Innovation and Disruption Agent v1.1

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: Experienced developers were 19% slower with early-2025 AI tools while believing they were faster (E8).
Danish administrative data show precise null effects on earnings and hours two years after ChatGPT (E9).
A task-based estimate puts the 10-year TFP gain below 0.66% (E10).
The best agent completed only 30% of realistic workplace tasks (E11); Gartner forecasts that over 40% of agentic AI projects will be canceled by 2027 (E12).
confidence_and_uncertainty: Moderate confidence in the classification; low confidence in vendor claims.
value_opportunity_implication: Faster learning could protect SPS's recruitment position if competitors gain an advantage.
risk_governance_implication: Same risks as the primary case; a faster timeline increases the chance of errors reaching applicants.
recommendation_management_implication: Accelerate the pilot design, aim for a two-quarter evaluation and prepare a broader rollout plan contingent on results; do not deploy fully now.
change_monitoring_triggers: Reassess if the vendor demonstrates its replacement claim.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: Vendor and peer claims are unverified.
